note: The growth step of the hourly tick (docs 10, 11). habitat: how the 1 m habitat grid is built from the water summary: moisture falls from fresh water to nothing over bankM; the tide band holds at least bandMoisture and bandSalt (0..255); salt falls from the sea and band over saltM. grass: painting decides where grass is at once; the grass cover per cell (how well grass likes the ground) follows the ground slowly, moving toward its target by ratePerH of the gap each game hour, so a dug pond drowns its grass over about a day and drained ground greens again; grass thins in standing water and on salty ground (saltFrom: thinning starts, saltFull: none from this salt up). maxPlants caps the individual plants on the island. species: the flora recipes that grow (recipes/flora/<id>.json).
